## Summary

- Add relative pipeline scheduling with months/days/hours/minutes, previous/next references, Russian relative labels, disabled inactive timing fields, and schedule border states.
- Keep disabled relative publish dates current when their reference stage date changes.
- Replace pipeline-specific visualizer presets with saved visualizer presets, including flat saved preset objects from the sidebar.
- Add album track file picking plus per-stage file reset buttons.
- Replace raw YouTube playlist ID fields with playlist checklist/create controls while preserving playlist ID upload metadata.
- Add a completion report for YouTube uploads sorted by publish date.
- Add per-stage and standalone YouTube playlist IDs, playlistItems insertion, combined OAuth scope handling, and preserved upload form options from PR #126.
- Constrain generated tooltips so long labels wrap inside the viewport.
- Preserve issue/PR/CI/git data, downloaded reviewer screenshot, verification logs, and root-cause analysis under `docs/case-studies/issue-131`.

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#131

## Screenshot

![Pipeline scheduling](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-audio-recorder-with-visualization/blob/issue-131-06cd8d2fd62d/docs/case-studies/issue-131/assets/pipeline-scheduling.png?raw=true)

## Case Study Artifacts

- Analysis: `docs/case-studies/issue-131/analysis.md`
- Reviewer tooltip screenshot: `docs/case-studies/issue-131/assets/pr-comment-4641540167-tooltip.png`
- Raw issue/PR/CI/git data and verification logs: `docs/case-studies/issue-131/logs/`

## Tests

- `npm run lint`
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm test`
- `npm run build`
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js`
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/youtube-upload-ui.cy.js`
- `npx cypress run` (55 passing)
